title_en: A Borrowed Dry Place: The Record

commands.text: The shelter opens onto a wall of pencilled heights. The smallest mark ends below Jori's shoulder.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: These marks belong in the register too.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: I only counted the hands that could lift a sack.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: Children are not the part of a load you can leave out.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: We cannot tell who lived from a mark alone. I will write 'family present', and keep the wall.
For the first time, Tovin carries something from the yard that cannot be sold.
